install.banner: Install Matchday Clock for quick access and offline use.

instructions.title: Install Matchday Clock
instructions.ios: In Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. In other iPhone browsers, open the share or browser menu and choose Add to Home Screen.
instructions.android: Open your browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
instructions.other: Use your browser's Install app or Add to Home screen option. If it is not available, check the browser menu.

install.failed: Could not start installation. Use your browser menu to install the app.

settings.pauseClockHelp: Automatically time the break after stopping a period
settings.keepAwakeHelp: While the match clock is running
settings.notificationHelp: Best effort; permission and platform support required
settings.trackHelp: Hold the hourglass to time a stoppage separately from the match clock

launch.title: Ready for matchday?
launch.description: Choose your usual match setup or configure a new one. The clock starts when you press Start.

setup.title: Match setup
setup.extraHelp: Two periods, using the length above

about.title: About
about.description: Matchday Clock runs locally on this device and can work offline.

about.platformNote: A web app cannot guarantee background execution or notifications on every phone. The clock uses saved timestamps to recover elapsed time when you return.

period.help: A new period starts at its match-time mark. The clock keeps running past the limit and turns red for stoppage time.
